headline: The Bull Case For Emerson Electric (EMR) Could Change Following Its Expanded Industrial AI Automation Push
summary: In late July and early August 2026, Emerson Electric expanded its industrial AI portfolio by launching the DeltaV Automation Platform for Data Centers, enhancing Nigel AI across NI’s software suite, and introducing Ovation AI Agents for power and water customers. Together, these offerings move Emerson further toward unified, AI-enabled automation that aims to simplify complex infrastructure control and build a foundation for more autonomous operations across data centers, test environments,...
